additional_info.subject: RE: ID0442308-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP/S8 170003983] QA21-22 is defective CRM:02889000384
additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes,
Hope you are doing well,
As per the reported issue DC_Contactor_QA21-22 is found to be in abnormal condition,
So, in this we need to check supply the voltage of coil QA21-QA22 (Voltage should be 24v across A1 and A2 terminal)
then further we could check contactor (Aux contacts) which wired to plc for status purpose,
And if the issue persists then need to replace it.
Kindly refer the below snapchat for troubleshoot the issue-:
8EM5903-0AA04-2AA8 -QA9, -QA10, ..., -QA24 Contactor M5 DC 2P 500A 1000V Nut

additional_info.subject: Note to RC-AT
additional_info.body: After investigating the number of QA21-22 units that failed to close during the cable check (see pictures below), I recommend replacing the contactors and the coupling relay :

KSW was on site only with contactos.
Contactors should be fine but since we got the recommentation to change both Contacotr and couple relay KSW will do in on site when we received our couple relays.

KSW changed DC Contator and Couple Relay.
Since KSW only had one test case with them and charging interruptions occurred, it cannot be said with certainty whether it was the test case or not, as it sometimes worked.
It was only noticed that the CP or PP contact looks somewhat worn out
